import outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning
import LongTails.Proofs.MuonNonconvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Proofs.MuonTuning

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

open outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning

theorem tuning_bounds (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public) (C : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n) (hC : 0 < C) (hΔ : 0 < p.Δ)
    (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hσ : 0 ≤ p.σ) :
    0 ≤ momentum p C ∧ momentum p C < 1 ∧ 0 < stepSize p C ∧
    1 ≤ horizon p C ∧ threshold p C ≤ (horizon p C : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem scalar_accuracy (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.Public) (C E : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n) (hC : 0 < C) (hΔ : 0 < p.Δ)
    (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hσ : 0 ≤ p.σ) (hE : E ≤ p.Δ) :
    let r : ℝ := (min p.m p.n : ℕ)
    let K : ℝ := horizon p C
    let β := momentum p C
    let η := stepSize p C
    E / (K * η) + C * η / 2 + 2 * p.σ * Real.sqrt (r * (1 - β)) / Real.sqrt (1 + β) +
      2 * β * p.σ * Real.sqrt r / ((1 - β) * K) + 2 * η * β * C / (1 - β) ≤ p.ε := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.MuonTuning
